purpose_context: The example docsite ships malformed diagram markup (every Mermaid figure is wrapped in a stray code-block box) and, because branding replaces the base stylesheet, global component styles (callouts today, diagrams next) never reach branded docs pages. This mission makes the diagram figure well-formed and ensures component CSS survives branding on both in-frame docs and out-of-frame decks. Closes #59, #60, #68.
purpose_tldr: Diagrams and Markua callouts render correctly on branded docs and decks — no double-boxed diagrams, no unstyled components.
